description: Disco Elysium: Game Boy Edition (fan demake, via RetroArch / mGBA)
long: Disco Elysium: Game Boy Edition is an unofficial fan demake of ZA/UM's acclaimed detective RPG, reimagined as a Game Boy Color cartridge. It compresses the original's dialogue-driven investigation and skill-check systems into a retro 8-bit presentation. The ROM is played through a Game Boy emulator.
